purpose: Emphasize concentration on one thing or repeated activity.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Noun + ばかり; て-form + ばかりいる.
My younger brother eats nothing but sweets.
On days off, I do little but sleep.
This shop is full of young people.
formation: Noun + ばかり; て-form + ばかりいる.
restrictions: Often suggests an imbalance; たばかり and approximate quantity ばかり are separate uses.
mistake: Do not treat every ばかり as just-finished time.
